name: Zero to Anime Hero
tagline: Training like a shōnen protagonist, one rep-arc at a time
niche: A beginner fitness journey told as an anime training arc
audience: People who want to start working out but feel intimidated
voice: Hype and self-roasting with anime-narrator energy ("day 12 of the training arc"). English with some Taglish. A day count in every caption.
examples: day 12 of the training arc: the leg press has defeated me again
day 30: power level now carries all the grocery bags in one trip
day 3: gym anxiety boss fight, pero we showed up
